name: STM32F103 MCU interrupt path
summary: MCU subsystems around a Boolean EXTI line, independent interrupt/event masks, and Cortex-M configurable-interrupt eligibility. Register/status snapshots are inputs; firmware and the pending-bit state machine are not executed.

sources.title: STM32F103C8 product specification
sources.locator: Product overview and All features; C8 device identifier

groups.label: EXTI and exception control
groups.description: One external interrupt line and its mask/qualification logic, not all NVIC state.

groups.label: Edge selection
groups.description: Rising/falling edge observations and their configured trigger enables.

groups.label: Interrupt and event masks
groups.description: IMR and EMR are active-high enables. A pending-bit snapshot and an edge observation serve distinct paths.

groups.label: Cortex-M3 core
groups.description: Processor and configurable interrupt masking. Instruction execution is not modeled.

groups.label: Flash and SRAM
groups.description: On-chip memory serving program and data accesses; contents and timing are outside this example.

groups.label: DMA and peripherals
groups.description: The MCU's bus-connected I/O context, distinct from a general-purpose application processor.

groups.label: Clock and reset
groups.description: Published clock/reset management context; no clock tree or electrical reset simulation.

inputs.label: Observed rising edge
inputs.description: One observed edge event. It is not a sampled GPIO level or a persistent pending bit.

inputs.label: Observed falling edge
inputs.description: Observed falling-edge event supplied by the environment.

inputs.label: RTSR rising enabled
inputs.description: True enables rising-edge detection for the selected line.

inputs.label: FTSR falling enabled
inputs.description: True enables falling-edge detection for this line.

inputs.label: PR pending snapshot
inputs.description: Observed EXTI pending bit. Edge generation and write-one-to-clear races are deliberately not simulated.

inputs.label: IMR interrupt enabled
inputs.description: IMR bit 1 unmasks/enables this interrupt request; zero masks it.

inputs.label: EMR event enabled
inputs.description: EMR independently enables the event path.

inputs.label: NVIC line enabled
inputs.description: Already-qualified NVIC enable state for the selected external interrupt.

inputs.label: PRIMASK blocks exceptions
inputs.description: True prevents configurable-priority exception activation. It does not clear pending state or mask NMI/HardFault.

inputs.label: Other priority checks pass
inputs.description: Contract input summarizing BASEPRI, FAULTMASK, active priority, and other eligibility conditions. No priority arbiter is implemented.

blocks.label: Rising-edge qualification
blocks.description: An observed rising edge is selected only when RTSR enables it.

blocks.label: Falling-edge qualification
blocks.description: An observed falling edge is selected only when FTSR enables it.

blocks.label: Selected EXTI edge
blocks.description: Either configured edge can activate the edge-event path. This output does not automatically update the supplied PR snapshot.

blocks.label: EXTI interrupt request
blocks.description: Pending EXTI status contributes an interrupt request while IMR is enabled.

blocks.label: EXTI event path
blocks.description: EMR qualifies the selected edge independently of interrupt masking and PRIMASK. This is event eligibility, not a measured pulse waveform.

blocks.label: Exception eligibility
blocks.description: Eligibility under the supplied NVIC and priority assumptions. It is not proof that an ISR has been entered.

blocks.label: Cortex-M3 CPU
blocks.description: The STM32F103C8 includes an Arm Cortex-M3 core.
blocks.reason: No Arm instruction execution, vector-table fetch, stacking, or interrupt entry cycles are implemented.

blocks.label: On-chip Flash
blocks.description: Program storage for the specific C8 variant, not the larger CB variant.
blocks.reason: Program contents, fetch timing, and Flash controller behavior are not modeled.

blocks.label: On-chip SRAM
blocks.reason: No memory values, bus access timing, or aliasing are modeled.

blocks.label: DMA controller
blocks.description: DMA supports transfers associated with timers, ADC, and serial peripherals.
blocks.reason: Channel state, requests, arbitration, and transfers are not executed.

blocks.label: APB peripheral buses
blocks.description: Two APB buses connect the documented peripheral set.
blocks.reason: An aggregated logical bus relationship, not a cycle-accurate bus fabric.

blocks.label: Timers / ADC / serial I/O
blocks.description: Representative timer, ADC, USB/CAN, and serial peripheral context; availability depends on the exact package/variant.
blocks.reason: No timer counters, ADC conversion, pin multiplexing, USB, or CAN state machines are executed.

blocks.label: Clock and reset control
blocks.description: Oscillator, PLL, reset, and supply-management context.
blocks.reason: No frequency, power, PLL lock, or reset distribution behavior is simulated.

connections.label: Program access
connections.description: Conceptual CPU program-memory relationship; no physical routing claim.

connections.label: Peripheral programming
connections.description: Aggregated register access through the MCU bus system.

connections.label: DMA-capable transfers
connections.description: Only peripherals supporting DMA use this conceptual path.

connections.label: Memory transfer context
connections.description: No buffer movement is executed by this architectural link.

connections.label: Exception entry boundary
connections.description: Eligibility reaches the unmodeled CPU; it must not be animated as firmware execution.

connections.label: Clock/reset context
connections.description: No functional clock domain is generated by the lab.

outputs.label: Exception eligible
outputs.description: Not an executed ISR or latency measurement.

requirements.text: Rising and falling observations are independently qualified by RTSR and FTSR.
IMR qualifies pending interrupt status; EMR qualifies the edge-event path independently.
PRIMASK, NVIC enable, and external priority qualification control eligibility without clearing supplied pending state.

assumptions: One EXTI line, valid register snapshots, and stable core mask state are supplied externally.
priority_ok summarizes conditions not represented by PRIMASK/NVIC enable; eligibility does not prove exception entry.
An observed edge and a PR pending snapshot are distinct inputs. Simultaneous set/clear races and hardware edge capture are not inferred.
omissions: Firmware/Arm ISA execution, EXTI PR storage and write-one-to-clear races, NVIC active/pending arbitration, exception entry and return.
Analog GPIO behavior, clock/reset timing, bus timing, power, complete DMA/peripheral state, electrical characteristics, and package pin mapping.
This control slice and logical subsystem map do not establish STM32F103C8 full-device conformance.
